steps.text: Use a pestle and mortar on the quicklime with a pot in your inventory.
Use a pestle and mortar on some sulphur.
Talk to the Chemist in Rimmington.
Use a barrel of coal on the still outside the Chemist's house.

Operate the still. To properly distill the barrel:  1. Turn the tar regulator valve all the way to the right. 2. Wait until the pressure is in the green, then turn the pressure valve to the middle. 3. Add 2 coal, and then 1 additional coal whenever the heat gauge falls below the green zone until the tar is distilled.
Make another barrel of naphtha for Mourning's End if you'd like, then add the quicklime to the naphtha.
Add the ground sulphur to the naphtha mix.
